{
  "IP": "neorv32_trng",
  "Conceptual Assets": [
    {
      "Concept ID": "C1",
      "Concept Name": "Generated entropy bytes",
      "Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Information": "Random bytes generated by the TRNG and buffered for bus reads; the IP depends on them to provide entropy that may be consumed as secrets or seeds.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "yes",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "yes: entropy bytes may be secret, and the FIFO value is exposed through the bus response at line 117; yes: the generated value is updated in the sampling register and output by the generator at lines 360 and 366, while the FIFO write path carries it at lines 139 and 161; yes: the enable and FIFO-clear paths can stop generation or discard the pool at lines 137 and 170, preventing the required read at line 117.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "C",
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could read buffered entropy through bus reads, or use reset, disable, or clear controls to disturb or suppress the values delivered to software.",
      "Enters Through": [],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"
      ],
      "Entry Lines": [],
      "Held Lines": [
        360,
        366
      ],
      "Exit Lines": [
        117
      ]
    },
    {
      "Concept ID": "C2",
      "Concept Name": "TRNG enable setting",
      "Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Information": "The runtime enable setting controls whether the entropy generator samples and fills the random pool; software depends on it to operate the TRNG.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "yes: enable is a runtime configuration setting that the bus write can modify at line 105; yes: clearing enable disables the generator through line 137 and also contributes to clearing the FIFO at line 170.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An unchecked bus write could clear the enable setting, disable entropy generation, and clear the random pool.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"
      ],
      "Entry Lines": [
        105
      ],
      "Held Lines": [
        95,
        105
      ],
      "Exit Lines": [
        109
      ]
    },
    {
      "Concept ID": "C3",
      "Concept Name": "Random-pool clear control",
      "Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Information": "The software-issued clear command decides whether buffered entropy is discarded, affecting the pool from which random bytes are returned.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "yes: the bus can set the clear command at line 106 and it controls deletion of buffered entropy through line 170; yes: asserting the command can empty the pool and withhold a required entropy transfer through line 170.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could issue an unrestricted clear command to discard available entropy and make subsequent random reads fail or return no data.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [],
      "Entry Lines": [
        106
      ],
      "Held Lines": [
        94,
        101,
        106,
        170
      ],
      "Exit Lines": []
    },
    {
      "Concept ID": "C4",
      "Concept Name": "Entropy read-dequeue control",
      "Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Information": "The read-enable decision consumes one buffered entropy byte and permits it to be returned on a bus read. It has no entry or exit port because request fields only decide this internal control.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "yes: the internally generated read-enable decision controls which entropy access consumes data, and it is produced from the bus request at line 171; yes: changing this decision can suppress a required entropy transfer or consume data on an unintended access at line 171.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "A fault or malicious manipulation of the dequeue decode could suppress valid reads or pop entropy without the intended bus access.",
      "Enters Through": [],
      "Leaves Through": [],
      "Entry Lines": [],
      "Held Lines": [
        171
      ],
      "Exit Lines": []
    }
  ],
  "Not Kept": [
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO availability and fill status",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "C1",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Debiasing intermediate state",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "C1",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Sampling counter and sequencing state",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "C1",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {

      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "",

    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Bus access command fields",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The strobe, direction, and address fields are access-command fields whose effects are represented by the kept settings and read-dequeue decision rather than being assets of their own."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Simulation mode and FIFO-depth build choices",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "These are build-time generic or constant choices that no element can change or withhold at run time."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Clock and reset",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_trng",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "Clock and reset inputs are excluded by the clock and reset rule and are not conceptual assets of this unit."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": []
}
